This '''individual''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] guard who was stationed at [[Mulvar Sensor Station]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''Although [[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]], the novel contains numerous flashbacks set in earlier years, including [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the guard was at a hallway intersection near the base's main computer laboratory when he was brought down with one punch by [[Shalla Nelprin]], a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Intelligence|Intelligence]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], who was on a [[Raid on Mulvar sensor station|mission]] with her fellow Wraiths [[Voort saBinring]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh]].<ref name="MK" />
